sense.definitionL2: Easily broken or damaged by a relatively small force; requiring careful handling.
coreFeatures: Describes a physical object or material.
A relatively small force can cause breakage or material damage.
Careful handling is needed because the object lacks sturdiness.

acquisitionProfile.minimumSufficientExperience: The learner anticipates damage from a small impact and handles the physical object carefully.
distinguishingFeatures: The referent is physical rather than an abstract situation.
A modest force can cause breakage, cracking, tearing, or similar damage.
The risk exists before the object is already damaged.

sketch.experienceGoal: Make the learner anticipate damage before any definition or target form is shown.
focalStructure: A thin glass cup is held in two hands.

sketch.learnerInference: This physical object can be damaged by a small force, so it must be handled carefully.

sense.definitionL2: To provide what is needed for an activity, state, or process to continue over time.
coreFeatures: An activity or state is already underway.
It could weaken, stop, or run out without support.
Resources, energy, attention, or conditions allow it to continue.

acquisitionProfile.minimumSufficientExperience: The learner sees a weakening process continue because a steady source of support crosses time.
distinguishingFeatures: The target causes an activity, state, or process to continue.
The support is active or sustaining rather than passive endurance.
The object is a process, system, activity, or state, not an injury event.

sketch.experienceGoal: Make a weakening process visibly continue because support arrives over time, without showing the target form.
focalStructure: A community activity is running but its resources are running low.
A regular stream of support arrives at several points in time.
The activity continues instead of stopping.
sketch.learnerInference: Ongoing support lets an activity or state continue across time.

mustAvoid: a one-time rescue with no continuation
